children: IBA weighing structured mechanism for sharing information relating to cyber security incidents among Banks

The IBA is developing a mechanism for banks to share cyber incident information and respond faster. Following a breach exposing 3,897 SBI customer records, SBI is investigating the cause and strengthening cybersecurity measures. The initiative aims to improve coordination and resilience across the banking sector.
Tata-Iveco aims for 6 lakh annual vehicle sales in five years; India assembly plans underway

Tata-Iveco Chairman N Chandrasekaran has set a five-year target of nearly six lakh vehicles annually for the $24-billion venture. Tata Motors is identifying Iveco models for assembly in India while exploring overseas expansion. The group aims to boost sales and margins by leveraging its capabilities across commercial vehicles and industrial engines. Delisting Iveco is also underway, with no timeline disclosed.
From gold coins to EVs, festive shopping goes beyond metros this Dhanteras

E-commerce and quick-commerce platforms are seeing a festive surge in jewellery, precious metals and two-wheeler purchases, including from smaller cities. Amazon India reported fashion jewellery shoppers rising over 50% year-on-year, while Instamart’s gold sales grew 258% and silver purchases increased 185%. Amazon also recorded sixfold growth in two-wheeler sales, with electric vehicle sales up eightfold.
US votes for mid-term elections, seen as referendum on Trump

Americans are voting in key midterm elections that could determine control of Congress and constrain President Donald Trump’s agenda. All 435 House seats and 37 Senate seats are at stake, with the vote seen as a referendum on Trump amid inflation, war and political divisions.
